definitions.full: H668. appiryon אַמִּרְיוֺן noun [masculine] sedan, litter, palanquin (so Late Hebrew; origin dubious; no plausible Shemitic etymology; perhaps (so RS in Yule Glossary of Anglo-Indian words, 502 ) Sanskrit paryanka , litter-bed, 'palankeen;' perhaps (if poem be late) Greek φορεῖον ; — ᵐ5 has φορεῖον , ᵑ9 ferculum , Syriac (and ) PS 3073 ; Sota 9:14 and Talmud אַמִּרְיוֺן , Talmud also מּוֺרְיָא and מּוֺרְיוֺן , Levy NHWB i.150, iv. 17. ) Song 3:9 ׳א שְׁלֹמֹה הֶמֶּלֶח לוֺ עָשָׂה .
